sentences.text: Utpal Sarkar & Ors vs The State Of W.B. & Ors on 5 June, 2023

Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 06
05.06.2023
 Ct. No.10
 b.das
 Wpa 2935 of 2018
 Utpal Sarkar & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of W.B. & Ors.

Mr. L. M. Mahata
 Ms. Jhuma Chakraborty ...for the State.
Heard learned counsels for the parties.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that being  aggrieved by the compensation granted to them for  acquisition of their land, they filed an application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 before  the learned Arbitrator.

The petitioners received payment  notice on ad hoc basis awarded under Section 3H of the  Act of 1956, but no copy of the arbitral award was served  upon them.
 The petitioners seek a direction upon the State  respondents to serve a copy of the arbitral award, if not already served, in order to enable them to approach the appropriate forum under Section 34 of the Utpal Sarkar & Ors vs The State Of W.B. & Ors on 5 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20464583/
1 Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
Learned counsel for the State respondents is unable to apprise this Court as to whether copy of the arbitral award has already been served upon the petitioners or not.

sentences.text: In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of directing the 3rd respondent to furnish a copy of the arbitral award upon the petitioners, if not already furnished, within 10 days from the date of communication of this order, in accordance with law.
With the above observations and directions this writ petition being WPA 2935 of 2018 is disposed of.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Since no affidavit is invited, the allegations contained in the petition are deemed not to be admitted.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
